sources.title: Headless mode
sources.version_scope: current unversioned documentation, not an installed-binary attestation
findings: init reports configuration; step_update covers transitions; result is terminal. No upper bound on the interval between these events is specified.
Closing stdin permits the active turn to finish before process exit. /model and /usage are separate CLI commands, not stream-json user turns.
--print-timeout bounds response waiting. It does not document a count of internal model requests.
stdout may contain tool arguments/results; stderr may contain error and permission details. These are not promised sanitized diagnostics.
sources.short_quote: The init payload records the run configuration.

sources.title: MCP
findings: stdio uses command/args and optional cwd/env under mcpServers.
The inspected guide does not specify a headless startup-failure deadline, mandatory fail-fast behavior after stdio exit, or a startup error event contract.

sources.title: Changelog - CLI entries
sources.version_scope: release notes; history is not proof that a behavior happened in a retained attempt

entries.finding: Advertises configurable MCP launch timeout, without a parameter name in that entry.
Headless/one-shot startup remains blocking for MCP tool loading.
Advertises in-process exponential-backoff retries for transient model errors, retaining completed tool outputs.
Introduces structured AGY_ERROR stderr metadata; changes unspecified headless timeout to unlimited.
Advertises server-requested rate-limit delay and stopping for delays above 30s or daily/billing caps.
Later fix caps retry waits at 30s rather than up to 4min. Earlier release notes do not prove every 1.3.1 path had that cap.

sources.short_quote: headless and one-shot runs keep blocking

sources.title: CLI commands
findings: No documented CLI setting for disabling or limiting internal model retry count was found in the inspected reference.

sources.title: CLI settings and tips
findings: No retry-count/backoff override was identified. This search result is a documentation limitation, not proof that no internal option exists.

not_a_CLI_control: RetryConfig and LocalAgentConfig retry settings found in SDK release notes belong to the Python SDK, not a verified override for this CLI.
operational_interpretation: Nodia/harness automatic_inference_retries=0 means no application resend. Native accepted-start counts are not upstream request counts.
init plus prompt_received without tools/result does not identify a network, quota, reasoning or retry cause.
AGY_ERROR can only supply evidence when actually emitted; no stderr means no such retained evidence.
Retain the current 120s outer bound and exact selection. This research authorizes no config/model/binary/timeout change.
potential_future_safe_diagnostic: If separately authorized, parse only an emitted AGY_ERROR structural allowlist (canonical status, numeric HTTP/gRPC code, retryable boolean) with byte/depth caps; omit message, error ID and nested data. This is a proposal, not implemented or verified against 1.3.1.
